messages:
carla: Quick sync — proposing a concise Launch Entrance rubric for the public release of tiered inference. Need fast surface-level ok from Docs, SRE, Billing, and Support before EOD.

Tom: Sounds good. Paste the high-level buckets?

carla: 5 buckets: safety/quality gating, SLA & latency SLOs, observability + alerting, docs/runbooks, pricing & quota plan. Short checklist per bucket with an owner.

anya: I can own docs/runbooks. Checklist items: quickstart, migration notes for Dedicated/Private, troubleshooting + rollback steps, minimal prompt-regression FAQ.

mike: Pricing/quota needs: fallback pricing for low-tier vs committed pools, burst rules, preview credits for early customers, and explicit behavior when KV cache is enabled.

Tom: SLA/SLO proposal: keep simple for GA: p95 latency <= 350ms for standard models, p95 <= 700ms for long-context; global error rate < 0.3% (5XX+timeout). Degradation policy: if p95 > 2x target for 15m, auto-fallback to compatible cheaper model variant.

sre-oncall-bot: Note: auto-fallback requires documented circuit-breaker (owner: eng-runtime) and a runbook step to roll back routing changes.

carla: Observability must include per-model token breakdown, trace -> user-request-id path, and a burn-rate dashboard for cost per token. Alerts: SLO burn > 60% in 5m, error spike > 0.5% in 1m.

anya: Docs: I'll add a one-page "Launch Quick Card" summarizing SLA, intended workload profiles, and recommended quantization/latency knobs per customer tier. Add SDK retry/backoff examples.

mike: Ops guardrail: limit free-tier QPS to 10 qps/account with explicit throttle message and billing link. Dedicated trial clause for overage handling during preview.

Tom: Support coverage: Tier 1 playbook in Customer Success and a dedicated oncall rotation for the first 72 hours post-launch for critical routing/throughput issues. Ownership: eng-platform + eng-sre pairing.

carla: Owners list: Docs = anya; SLA/SLO + runbook = tom; Pricing/quota = mike; Observability dashboards = eng-infra (owner: micah, cc tom); 72-hour rota = eng-sre lead (TBD).

anya: Do we require model regression tests before rollout? Suggest a 3k-prompt smoke set covering client-critical intents with a quality floor (similarity threshold). If regression detected, block rollout.

mike: Tie regression test to rollout flag. Also request cost-sim before enabling quantization for Dedicated customers.

carla: Proposed gating to move from beta -> public launch: (1) all checklist items green, (2) regression pass on smoke set, (3) SRE load test simulating 2x expected traffic for 30m with p95 within target, (4) pricing doc and billing link live, (5) 72-hour rota staffed.

Tom: Timeline: if Docs & Pricing ok today, eng-runtime can finish fallback wiring by Wed, infra dashboards by Thu, and schedule load test Fri.

anya: I'll publish the quickstart + rollback steps by EOD and link to the checklist doc.

mike: I'll update pricing page and quota table with throttle messaging, ping finance for wording by 3pm.

carla: Any non-negotiable blockers? Call them out now.

Tom: Non-negotiable: fallback routing and rollback automation must be tested; no manual-only emergency paths.

anya: Non-negotiable for Docs: a short runbook with explicit escalation steps and contact matrix.

mike: Non-negotiable: explicit overage policy for Dedicated trial customers so sales + finance can sign.

carla: I'll compile this into a one-page Launch Entrance rubric and owner assignments, post to the launch tracker, reconvene tomorrow 10am for final go/no-go. :thumbsup: 

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window scheduled 2025-05-10 02:00 UTC — confirm rota if go.

anya: Ack, will be oncall for first 12 hours.

mike: I'll be available for billing edgecases after deploy.

carla: Thanks team — closing thread, will upload rubric doc shortly.
